rows.en:
(Taking a walk in the park like this
once in a while isn't bad.)

(Huh, wait, is that Michel?
What's he doing in a place like this?)
Hey, Michel!
rows.notes: x5: male player calling out in frd_mcl_005/006/114 and nml_mcl_016.

rows.en:
Hm, \p?
What are you doing in a place like this?

It was nice out, so I came for a little walk.
What about you, Michel? What are you doing here?
I'm out for a walk too.

Huh~, I see.
Do you come to Central Park a lot, Michel?

Now and then. When I was little,
I used to play here with Klan a lot.

So you and Klan-senpai have been close
since way back, huh.
Hmph. Well, we're childhood friends, after all.
(He just won't admit it.)
rows.notes: Both genders; sunao ja nai = not honest about his feelings for Klan.

rows.en: Man, this really takes me back...

Klan and I would play until the sun went down,
and then Sis would come to pick us up...
rows.notes: Both genders. nesan = Michel's own older sister; kinship word -> 'Sis' per brief.

rows.en: Sis...
Um... What's wrong, Michel?
No, it's nothing... Don't worry about it.

(Nothing, he says...
It sure doesn't look like nothing......)

(Isn't there some way
I can cheer Michel up...?)
(Oh, I know!)

Michel!
Let's play here right now,
like you did when you were little!
Huh? Where's this coming from all of a sudden?

You used to play here a lot, right?
Being a kid again once in a while isn't so bad.
I-is that a no...? Michel?
...Geez, I guess you leave me no choice......
But if we're doing this, I'm going all out!
Ahh~, I'm beat~

You said it...
But just playing around without a thought
in my head like this isn't half bad.
Yeah, you're right.
Today was a really nice change of pace.
rows.notes: Both genders. 'change of pace' as finished slices.

rows.en: I had a lot of fun too.

Sorry... for making you go to all that
trouble for me...
rows.notes: Both genders. Said half to himself; the player does not catch it (c10027).

rows.en: Hm? What?
Nah, it's nothing.

Well then...
The sun's about to go down, so I'll head home.
See you.
Yeah, see you.
rows.notes: x7, all the male player (frd_mcl, frd_myk, frd_yui, nml_mcl). As c08128.

rows.en:
(Phew~ I never imagined I'd end up
playing in the park with Michel...)

(Michel seemed to have fun too,
so maybe I'll invite him out again sometime?)

(Taking a walk in the park like this
once in a while isn't bad.)

(Wait, is that Michel-kun?
I wonder what he's doing in a place like this.)
Hey, Michel-kun!
rows.notes: x5: female player in frd_mcl_005/006/114 and nml_mcl_016.

rows.en:
It was nice out, so I came for a little walk.
What about you, Michel-kun?
What are you doing here?

Huh~, I see.
Do you come to Central Park a lot, Michel-kun?

So you and Klan-senpai have been close
since way back.
Um... What's wrong, Michel-kun?

(Nothing, he says...
It sure doesn't look like nothing......)

(Isn't there some way
I can cheer Michel-kun up...?)
(Oh, I know!)

Michel-kun!
Let's play here right now,
like you did when you were little!

You used to play here a lot, right?
Being a kid again once in a while
isn't bad at all.
I-is that a no...? Michel-kun?
Ahh~, I'm so tired~
I had a lot of fun too.

(Phew~ I never imagined I'd end up
playing in the park with Michel-kun...)

(Michel-kun seemed to have fun too,
so maybe I'll invite him out again sometime?)

(Phew~ Central Park really is
the best place to unwind.)

Yo, \p.
Fancy meeting you at Central Park again.
Oh, did you come for a walk again too, Michel?
Yeah, something like that.

Hey, since we're here,
want to play around here like last time?

I've got my part-time job after this.
Sorry, but I'll have to pass.
Okay, see you.

(Maybe it's just me, but Michel seemed more
cheerful than when we met here last time...)

(Did he finally sort out whatever
was bothering him?)

(Phew~ Central Park really is
the best place to unwind.)

Oh, did you come for a walk again too,
Michel-kun?

Hey, since we're here,
want to play around here like last time?
Okay, see you.

(Maybe it's just me, but Michel-kun seemed more
cheerful than when we met here last time...)

uncertain: c10008/c10009: nesan = Michel's own late older sister; rendered 'Sis' (kinship word, per brief).
c10026: Michel's apology is half to himself (the player asks 'What?' next); rendered as thanks-for-the-trouble apology.
c10030 'Yeah, see you.' (x7) serves the male player in frd_myk/frd_yui/nml_mcl too; as c08128.
